run_beam_search: run beam search sequence generation on an image-to-text model with configurable beam size
create_sequence_generator: create a SequenceGenerator with custom beam size, max length, and length normalization parameters
build_sequence: build a Sequence object with output word ids, model state, logprob, and score
use_topn_tracker: use TopN to maintain and extract the top n elements from an incremental set
review_beam_search: review the beam_search method to understand how partial and complete sequences are managed
